newsitem.title: INDIA: India IFCI up six pct on 96/97 results.
newsitem.headline: India IFCI up six pct on 96/97 results.

text.p: Shares of Industrial Finance Corporation of India (IFCI) rose 1.75 rupees, or nearly six percent to 31.25 at the Bombay exchange on Monday after the firm announced a rise in its 1996/97 net profits, traders said.
The term lending institution last week said its net profit in the year ending March 31, 1997 climbed to 3.79 billion rupees from 3.55 billion in the year-ago period.
IFCI announced a higher dividend of 30 percent for 1996/97 against 25 percent last year.
Over 1.13 million shares of IFCI changed hands at the Bombay Stock Exchange by late afternoon on Monday.
At the National Stock Exchange, IFCI gained 1.05 rupees at 31.20 with 610,300 shares traded.
